text: MIME refresh removal records the live meta list length and visits Item(i - 1) from the end toward zero before removing a matching node. This avoids shifting later unvisited entries when removing from this list. Retain the reverse traversal or another mutation-safe approach in this specific DOM cleanup. This is a source-derived manual iteration recommendation, not a project-wide requirement to reverse all loops. This is static source evidence.
